messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (hosted, us-east-1). p95=4200ms p99=8300ms, error rate within threshold but streaming stalls increased. Trigger: sustained >5m. Pager: #oncall. link: https://telemetry.redwood/slo/alerts/1786543210

sara: @kev-oncall on call? seeing a spike in tail latency across shards, lots of streaming stalls reported by clients.

kev-oncall: I’m up. pulling traces and kapacitor logs now. will check routing and cache hit rates.

mike-ml: quick note — model runtime metrics show KV cache miss rate jumped from ~6% -> ~68% starting at 1786541200. prefix-cache hit rate dropped accordingly. suspect prefix hashing change in the 00:15 deploy.

kev-oncall: grabbing recent deploys. deploy-bot shows rollout 2026-03-14T00:12 by @sam-sre: feature "prefix-hash-v2" enabled (gradual rollout 20%).

sam-sre: yep that rollout toggled a new prefix hashing function to improve sharding. I can flip the flag.

liz-product: hearing from a major customer (AcmeChat) about streaming stalls mid-conversation, they see stalled tokens for ~3-5s. This is hurting interactive UX.

kev-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) immediate rollback/disable prefix-hash-v2 2) enable warm-cache job to prepopulate common prefixes 3) temporarily increase cache TTL and add fallback routing to smaller model variant if stall >2s. any objections?

mike-ml: +1. also we should throttle new incoming long sequences to avoid filling up KV due to churn.

kev-oncall: executing steps. sam — can you flip the feature flag and stop the deployment?

sam-sre: on it. toggling flag now. command:
```
# toggle flag
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/flags/prefix-hash-v2 -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
```
response: 200 OK - flag disabled. deploy-bot: pausing rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for prefix-hash-v2 due to manual toggle by sam-sre. rollback recommended.

kev-oncall: rolling back canary to prior config for affected shards. running kubectl rollout undo for inference-service on pool-us-east-1-canary.

kev-oncall: command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-service-canary --to-revision=23`

kev-oncall: started cache-warm job (ad-hoc) to pre-warm top prefixes:
```
python tools/warm_cache.py --prefix-list top_10k --region us-east-1
```

mike-ml: warming job logs show initial hit rate improvement for those prefixes. overall cache hit rate improving from 32% -> 68% within 6 minutes for warmed keys. tail latency trending down on shard-7.

kev-oncall: also routing fallback enabled: if streaming stall > 2s, route request to model-variant-small in same region. command: `POST /admin/routing/enable-fallback?route=/v1/generate&variant=model-small`

liz-product: informing affected customers via status page and priority support. posting note: "We are investigating increased latency for streaming APIs in us-east-1; temporary mitigations in progress."

sam-sre: after rollback & flag off, baseline metrics: p95=780ms (was 4200), p99=1300ms (was 8300), streaming stall count down 88%.

kev-oncall: great. leaving a few monitoring runbooks to watch: 1) prefix-cache-hit-rate 2) streaming-stall-count 3) p99 latency. setting alerts tighter for next 2 hours.

mike-ml: root cause notes: prefix-hash-v2 changed how short prefixes were hashed creating hot/ cold splits; cache key normalization mismatch caused many keys to miss. adding unit + integration tests to catch normalization divergence.

sam-sre: PR to revert normalization logic opened: https://git.redwood/repo/prefix-hash/pull/345 (description: revert to stable hashing and add compatibility shim).

kev-oncall: handing off to @oncall-night for monitoring through night. summary: rollback complete, warming job in progress, fallback routing active, customer comms posted. severity: sev2 -> monitoring.

oncall-night: acknowledged. I’ll watch alerts and escalate if p99 climbs above 2s again. please add any followup tasks to the incident board.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: SLO back within thresholds for /v1/generate in us-east-1. p95=720ms p99=980ms. Incident duration ~1h12m. tagging: cache, prefix-hash, rollback, mitigation.

kev-oncall: adding retro notes: require canary perf tests that include prefix cache warm-up simulation; add preflight integration test that compares prefix normalization outputs between old/new hashing functions.

mike-ml: will prepare regression test and add synthetic workload to CI that simulates long chat sessions and streaming stalls.

liz-product: will follow up with impacted customers with timeline and actions.

sam-sre: closing runbook tasks, will merge revert PR after review and schedule controlled rollout with extra telemetry. :white_check_mark:
